title: Float and clear: legacy understanding and modern alternatives
learningObjectives: Explain float and clear: legacy understanding and modern alternatives and build a practical layout with it.

understand.concept: float was designed to let content such as text wrap around an image or other floated box. clear controls whether an element can sit beside floats. Modern page and component layouts should usually use flexbox or grid rather than floats.
understand.whyItMatters: Float remains relevant in existing stylesheets and for text wrapping around media. Understanding it helps maintain legacy pages, but it is not a general-purpose column layout tool.
understand.analogy: A float lets text flow around an object, like text wrapping around a picture in a magazine.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; actual flex layout follows the flex formatting algorithm and writing-mode rules.

explain.narrative: The first paragraph wraps around the floated box. The final paragraph clears the float and starts below it.

practise.guidedTask: Recreate a text-wrapping image with float:left and compare it with a flexbox layout. Explain when each is appropriate.
practise.independentTask: Build a responsive component using this concept. Test long labels, narrow widths, and keyboard navigation.

questions.prompt: Which property prevents an element from sitting beside preceding floats?
questions.explanation: clear controls whether an element may be positioned beside floated elements.
